data.exact_reserve_text: The result for the year included net prior year reserve releases of GBP 2.1m (2020: reserve release of GBP 4.8m) and benefited the combined ratio by 1.5% (2020: benefit of 3.9%). The treaty reinsurance classes of business contributed most of the prior year reserve releases.
data.standardized_narrative: Using the syndicate's gross claims development table, prior-year re-estimation produced a net strengthening (adverse movement) of approximately GBP 7.57m (1.88% of opening gross claims outstanding). The Managing Agent reports a net prior year release of GBP 2.1m after reinsurance, with treaty reinsurance classes contributing most to the net release; however on a gross basis the development in older underwriting years is a small deterioration. Causes cited include lower frequency and severity of catastrophe and large loss events (supporting favourable development in some years) and the effect of reinsurance recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: The current year results have been positively impacted by lower levels of frequency and severity in catastrophe and large loss events.
The result for the year included net prior year reserve releases of GBP 2.1m (2020: reserve release of GBP 4.8m) and benefited the combined ratio by 1.5% (2020: benefit of 3.9%).
The treaty reinsurance classes of business contributed most of the prior year reserve releases.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities) claims outstanding prior-year column (2020). No explicit gross 'prior year reserve movement' figure presented; gross prior-year development computed from the gross claims development triangle (gross triangle used as primary gross source). The managing agent narrative reports a NET prior year release of GBP 2.1m (after reinsurance) which differs from the gross triangle-derived movement. All source triangle numbers were presented in GBP 000 and converted to millions. LOB-specific reserve movements are not quantified in the report; lob_movements amounts are null and based on narrative inference.
